name: SpecSuite-Core
description: SpecSuite-Core is a benchmark of four deeply-specified AI agents spanning policy compliance, grounded analytics, runbook adherence, and deterministic enforcement, used to evaluate the Test-Driven AI Agent Definition (TDAD) methodology.
reputation: A niche benchmark used mainly to evaluate TDAD-style agent specification compliance, with limited public adoption so far.
notes: Benchmark is used to evaluate AI agent prompt compilation and behavioral compliance with tests, including mutation testing and regression safety.
